name: adversarial-contradictions
description: Tests whether the system's contradiction detector (Tool 5) surfaces conflicting facts. Pairs of memories with >50% Jaccard vocabulary overlap but contradictory claims are stored; recall must return both entries, proving neither was silently deduped and that the conflict was registered.

examples.query: What port does the server run on?
expectedMemories: The production server runs on port 3000 in config.json
The production server runs on port 8080 in docker-compose.yml

seeds.content: The production server runs on port 3000 in config.json
The production server runs on port 8080 in docker-compose.yml

seeds.content: Production database uses PostgreSQL with read replicas configured
Production database uses SQLite with no read replicas configured
